key_points: Chevron plans to ramp up the number of wells drilled next year, indicating higher future production.
U.S. oil imports from Venezuela have surged to a 9‑year high, positioning Chevron to benefit from increased Venezuelan crude.
Chevron and ExxonMobil are doubling down on LNG investments, supporting long‑term gas demand exposure.
Despite a recent 2.6‑2.7% stock drop on oil‑price pressure, Chevron posted its highest revenue in four years.
Analysts emphasize CVX’s fortress balance sheet and strong cash flow as a defensive advantage versus peers.
